facts.fact: The heavy-set queen's guard who said no in Kodiyur and yes at dusk is paired with Vasu, a Kettamala spearman (his mother keeps ducks at Kalladi). Her shape is low, quick and grey-brown, unnamed. She is cut across the shoulder; Vasu drops under the share and the line gaps.
facts.why: needed because the outline requires a newly bound pair, a guard and a Kettamala spearman, to falter; ch24 left several namings unspecified.

facts.fact: The spear goes through under Devan's right collarbone and out at the back; his right hand is dead and will not close. The shaft is broken off short by an unseen hand.
facts.why: outline beat; sets up Thankam's finding in ch26.

facts.fact: Neela takes scored welts on the ribs and shoulder in leopard shape, and Devan feels hook drags along his side, before the spear.
facts.why: shows the share working in the line before the mortal wound.

facts.fact: Vellan leaves his unbound post at the narrow place at the top of the cut to fill the gap; the narrow place is open behind the line when Devan loses consciousness.
facts.why: outline has the bear come over the cut; ch26 has him holding the cut alone, so the post is understood to be re-taken.
